Same headline; file chips snapped into a tidy aligned column on the 40px grid.
Four stacked pill-waveform version tracks, lime playhead at 30 percent, four verbs stacked in ink.
Playhead at 70 percent, a second track highlighted with lime played pills and a lime underline hairline on one verb.
Dark instrument photo on the upper half, FOCUS ON THE MUSIC emphasised in ink, the second line dimmer.
Both lines full ink with lime full stop; calm pill strip below fully lime-played, representing handled files.
Black grid canvas, sonicdesk wordmark with lime full stop, offer text in lime, faint ink pills.
Same layout plus the square lime SIGN UP button with near-black text; the offer stays lime.
